title: A Change of Jazz
style: Ultra-quiet off-kilter jazz at half volume, built around a drip-click-hum motif that starts staggered then settles into a soft swing pocket. Walking upright bass or lyrical fretless bass, warm Rhodes comping, sparse piano voicings, brushed snare, hushed ride cymbal, close-mic breathy vocals, tape saturation, soft room reverb, and subtle horn counterlines., shamanic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They said, "A change will do you good"
Now, that's a phrase misunderstood
I'm here to tell you somethin' else
About a kind of music for yourself

[Chorus]
And that's why jazz can never go
'Cause jazz is here to stay
Jazz is keepin' the world on its feet
And now the world's on its way

[Verse 2]
If you need an example, take the bass
They put the bass on everything
That's the funk, the soul, the disco, the hip-hop
The techno, the house, the drill, the Afrobeat
The music, it's never gonna stop

[Chorus]
That's why jazz can never go
'Cause jazz is here to stay
Jazz is keepin' the world on its feet
And now the world's on its way
Jazz can never go
'Cause jazz is here to stay
Jazz is keepin' the world on its feet
And now the world's on its way

[Outro]
A change of jazz
A change of jazz
A change of jazz
